messages:
emma: FYI we observed rising NIC crc errors and occasional nvlink resets in apac-south1 during the last night soak. Proposing a staggered maintenance: Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC (split into 4 cohorts) to soft-reboot BMC/NIC and apply a conservative microcode. Estimated transient capacity dip ~10%.

davide: Ack. Any scheduler evictions tied to this yet?

emma: Two transient evictions during the peak minute, nothing persistent. Root cause likely NIC microcode + vendor driver mismatch.

emma: Plan: cohorts C1..C4, canary C1 (5% nodes) 23:00-23:20, then C2 23:30-00:30, C3 00:40-01:20, C4 01:30-02:00. Canary success: no P95 increase >2% and nvlink resets <=1.

sophia: Runbook please (commands + checks).

emma: Short runbook: annotate nodes maintenance=true, drain gracefully, run nic-check, soft BMC reboot, run nvlink selftest, uncordon, prefix-cache warm. Abort if any criteria hit.

sophia: Paste commands for ops.

emma: Commands:
# annotate+drain
kubectl annotate node NODE maintenance=true --overwrite
kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180 --timeout=6m
# nic check (internal)
nic-health --node NODE --summary
# soft bmc reboot
ssh root@BMC "bmcreboot --soft"
# nvlink check
sudo /usr/local/bin/nvlink-check --quick
# uncordon + warm cache
kubectl uncordon NODE
prefixwarm --pool apac-south1 --node NODE --wait=600

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created; PagerDuty reminder 40m before.

davide: Cost estimate for backfill? finance wants ballpark.

emma: Worst-case backfill (on-demand) ~ $3.5k/hr for apac-south1, 3h window ~ $10.5k. Will tag instances to cost center.

sophia: Tenants pinned? Any high-priority workloads?

emma: Two high-priority customers pinned. Plan: pre-migrate one during low traffic; other uses reserved capacity. Notify owners 48h and 1h prior.

davide: Routing change? Prefer region fallback for new sessions during window?

emma: Yes, will apply routing bias to prefer APAC fallback (apac-west) for new sessions 22:50-02:30 UTC.

sophia: Who's oncall and who leads canary?

emma: Oncall = davide, canary lead = sophia, operators = emma + davide. Channel = #eng-infra-maint pinned.

emma: Abort criteria: P95 delta >2% sustained 5m OR evictions >5 OR nvlink resets >2 per node. Will publish final runbook and post schedule here. :thumbsup:
